method: TEXT/CANDIDATE REVIEW ONLY - no pixel verification
method_note: The session model (deepseek/deepseek-flash) has no native vision, and the harness vision proxy reached via read ?q= is not usable here. The repo's own bake-off (eval/runs/notebook_v1/vision_bakeoff.json) found that across 17 models and two settings nothing reproduced all three pupil strings and 'No model on this account is usable as a second annotator on these three crops', with hallucination as the failure mode. My own spot reads on page 34 and page 37 produced contradictory and confabulated text for the same ink. Per the parent method-correction of 2026-09-14 this proposal is a text/candidate triage: it lists POSSIBLE errors with the exact line text and a reason, verified_from_pixels=false throughout, and makes no transcript corrections. Astra must inspect the cited pixels directly.
